Subject: OrchidLab external pentest — executive summary (Redwood Inference)

Hi Jasmine —

Attached is the executive summary and finding matrix from the external engagement conducted 2026-10-10 to 2026-10-22. Key points (high-level):
- Scope: hosted inference runtime, control-plane API, model-loading S3 interface.
- Findings: 1 high (privilege escalation in internal admin API, CVE assigned), 3 medium (insecure TLS config on legacy endpoint, token leak possibility in debug logs, outdated dependency with known CVE), 5 low (info disclosure, minor misconfigurations).
- Risk posture: none are immediate data-exfiltration vectors; however privilege escalation requires priority mitigation.
- Remediation status: vendor-verified fixes for the high finding applied to staging 2026-11-24; mitigation steps documented. Remaining medium findings are scheduled with target remediation by 2026-12-10.

Attachments: [Attachment: PenTest_Summary_OrchidLab_2026-11-30.pdf (pdf, 2.3MB)]

Let us know if you need deeper logs or raw test artifacts; we can provide on a case-by-case basis under an NDA.

Regards,
Maya Chen
Senior Consultant, OrchidLab Security

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>

Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-03 10:22 -0800
Subject: Patch SLA and remediation ownership matrix (draft)

Jasmine / Neha —

Attached is the draft patch and remediation SLA workbook we discussed. Highlights:
- Critical (CVE with active exploit / high severity): target detection + patch or mitigation in <= 48 hours; full remediation and post-deploy verification within 7 calendar days.
- Important/High: mitigate within 7 calendar days; verify within 14 days.
- Moderate/Low: triage within 14 days; scheduled in next maintenance window (typically monthly).
- Emergency rollback and failover: we maintain a warm standby configuration for control-plane in our dedicated clusters; rollback tested quarterly.

Remediation ownership (examples):
- Admin API privilege escalation (OrchidLab high finding) -> Owned by Runtime Security (Marcus) + Patch deployment (SRE) -> Completed to staging 2026-11-24, PR merged 2026-11-26.

Attachments: [Attachment: patch_plan_redwood_2026-12-03.xlsx (xlsx, 120KB)]

I'll open Jira tickets and link to SEC-4312 after you sign off.

--
Marcus Lin
Staff SWE, Runtime Security | Redwood Inference
